title: students_added
description: The facts the message kind students_added (students were added to your class) can use. A fact schema is the one definition of what a template of this kind may mention: the Console offers exactly these as placeholders and the checker refuses any other. Facts marked x_derived are worked out by the kind's fact builder in the product, not typed by anyone and not computed by the template.

x_kind.name: Students added (students were added to your class)
triggers: One or more students are placed in a class (assigned, confirmed or on the waiting list) from the Console (automatic). Every instructor placed in that class is told, one message per placement, listing everyone added.
x_kind.recipient: individual: each instructor placed in the class (primary and secondary).
x_kind.dedupe: explicit key: kind + instructor + a digest of the attendance ids placed together

name.description: How the email greets the instructor: their given name, else their display name, else the word there.

when_day.description: The day in words, in the class's time zone.

when_span.description: The start and end times with the zone abbreviation, in the class's time zone.

when_short.description: A short day and start time for subject lines.

time_zone.description: The class's time zone as an IANA name; America/Denver if none is set. An unknown name shows times in UTC.

venue.description: The venue's name. Absent when none.

room.description: The room label at the venue. Absent when none.

where.description: Venue and room together, joined with a middle dot. Absent when both are absent.
examples: Ozo's Coffee, East Pearl · Back room

address.description: The venue's address on one line. Absent when none.

summary.description: One plain sentence saying who was added and who is on the waiting list, for example: Bob Guest and Cy were added to your class. Ann Able is on the waiting list.
examples: Bob Guest and Cy were added to your class.
